name: Roman Empire
overview: Scripture reveals the Roman Empire as the governing authority during the time of Christ and the early church, ruled by emperors such as Augustus Caesar, Tiberius Caesar, Claudius Caesar, and Nero. The empire’s legal and social structures are evident in the rights of Roman citizenship, which could be obtained by birth or purchase, granting privileges like the right of trial and appeal. These realities shaped the context of the gospel’s spread, as seen in Paul’s confident assertion of his Roman citizenship when asserting his legal protections.
